fields.statement: At a201949 (includes 0783bed sign-off under the run's lock and f194355 tidy): review-signoff.txtar shows a review run stopped at signoff with signoff_waiting true until rhiza run approve, then succeeded with one signoffs entry {actor test, outcome approved, rule owner, step signoff, visit 1}; review-signoff-changes.txtar shows run request-changes with one finding on leaf thing, after check alpha used cycles 1-3, start fixer for thing (cycle 4, findings=yes, commit Leaf: thing), its verifier, alpha re-run, and the run waiting at signoff again, a third request refused exit 2 with the journal unchanged; review-signoff.txtar shows approve and request-changes exit 2 with no run, a run stopped at another step, and a finished run, journal lines unchanged; review-signoff-autonomous.txtar shows an --autonomous run pass signoff with a journal entry rule autonomous, outcome approved, no actor; describe-golden matches. internal/api TestSignoffUnderLockHeld, TestSignoffRecheckedUnderLock, TestSignoffAlreadySignedUnderLock, TestSignoffUnderLockJournalsOnce pass; git show 0783bed f194355 read: Engine.Continue takes the lock, re-reads the journal and runs the sign-off checks (signoffWaitingStep plus same step/visit) before appending, a refusal writes nothing. Hands-on with a scratch build and fake claude/rex: 12 trials of concurrent rhiza run approve + rhiza run request-changes on a review run waiting at sign-off (launch order alternated). Every trial journalled exactly one type=signoff entry for visit 1, and its outcome was that of the command that exited 0 (6 approve wins: run succeeded; 6 request-changes wins: fixer for beta ran, run waits at signoff visit 2). The loser exited 3 (running in another process) or 2 (finished, or running, from the pre-lock check) and wrote no sign-off.
